items.title: France reports first human case of livestock virus Shamonda after patient dies
items.brief: France on Thursday reported the first human case of the Shamonda virus usually found in livestock in a patient who later died, with authorities adding there was no risk to the general population at this stage.

items.title: Construction on Trump’s 250-foot triumphal arch in DC could begin in just two weeks

items.title: Massive strikes hit Kyiv hours after Putin agrees to fresh peace talks
items.brief: Russia attacked the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv in a massive missile attack overnight into Thursday, hours after President Vladimir Putin said the Kremlin was ready to resume trilateral peace talks next month.
